teaser: The habit of finishing what others only sketch sits early in a life path 22. You are a 22, the compound number your birth date adds up to before it is reduced to the single digit 4 — the total of its digits before that last reduction — carrying a reputation as a builder of things that outlast you. Crossed with an INTJ, a mind built to plan ten moves out and test every assumption before trusting it, something specific happens: the vision does not stay an idea for long. It gets a budget, a timeline, a materials list. What makes this reading distinct is how fast the dream turns into a structure with load-bearing walls.
excerpt: 'You already decided this before she finished the sentence,' a partner says, watching you fold the evening's parent-teacher conference into a plan before the teacher has said more than hello.
